name: slack
description: Slack connector — list channels, read messages, and post via the Slack Web API

ai.insodimension.dimension.title: Slack
examples: Post a message to #general letting the team know the deploy is done
Summarize the last 20 messages in the #incidents channel
Find the message where someone shared the staging URL in #engineering

setup.title: Create a Slack app
setup.detail: At api.slack.com/apps click "Create New App" → "From scratch", give it a name (e.g. "Dimension"), and pick the workspace you want it to act in.

setup.title: Add Bot Token Scopes
setup.detail: In your app: OAuth & Permissions → Scopes → Bot Token Scopes → add channels:read, groups:read, channels:history, groups:history, and chat:write. These let the bot list channels, read history, and post.

setup.title: Install the app to your workspace
setup.detail: OAuth & Permissions → Install App → Install to Workspace → Allow. This generates the bot token.

setup.title: Copy the Bot User OAuth Token
setup.detail: Still on OAuth & Permissions, copy the "Bot User OAuth Token" (it starts with xoxb-) and paste it into the form below. It stays on this machine. Note: invite the bot into any channel with /invite before it can read or post there.

form.label: Bot User OAuth Token
form.help: From your Slack app's OAuth & Permissions page (starts with xoxb-). Install the app to your workspace first to generate it.

failures.title: Reconnect Slack — the bot token is invalid or revoked
failures.detail: Reinstall the app to your workspace and paste the fresh xoxb- token.

failures.title: Add the missing bot scopes
failures.detail: OAuth & Permissions → Bot Token Scopes → add channels:read, channels:history, chat:write — then reinstall the app.

tools.name: slack_list_channels
tools.description: List public and private channels in the connected Slack workspace. Returns id/#name/topic per line; paginate with the returned cursor.

tools.name: slack_read_messages
tools.description: Read recent messages from a Slack channel (most-recent first). Returns ts/user/text per line — ts is the message id.

tools.name: slack_post_message
tools.description: Post a message to a Slack channel. DESTRUCTIVE — confirm the channel and text with the user first. Returns the posted ts + channel.

tools.name: slack_read_thread
tools.description: Read the replies in a Slack thread (oldest first). Pass the parent message's ts as threadTs. Returns ts/user/text per line.

tools.name: slack_reply_thread
tools.description: Reply inside a Slack thread. DESTRUCTIVE — confirm the channel, thread, and text with the user first. Returns the reply ts + channel.

tools.name: slack_add_reaction
tools.description: Add an emoji reaction to a message (emoji name without colons, e.g. thumbsup). Requires the reactions:write scope.

tools.name: slack_edit_message
tools.description: Edit a Slack message the bot posted (chat.update). DESTRUCTIVE — confirm the channel, ts, and new text with the user first.

tools.name: slack_delete_message
tools.description: Delete a Slack message (chat.delete). IRREVERSIBLE — confirm the exact channel and message ts with the user; it cannot be undone.

tools.name: slack_list_users
tools.description: List workspace members. Returns id/@name/real name per line (deleted + bots flagged). Requires the users:read scope.
